<entry id="M02441">
<head-word>מַקְצוּעָה</head-word>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="M02440">preced.</xref> wds.) 
<italic>stored fruits</italic>, esp. 
<italic>fig</italic>-
<italic>cake.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<italic>—</italic>
<plural-form>Pl. מַקְצוּעוֹת</plural-form>. Ned. VIII, 4 (61
<sup>b</sup>) עד שיקפלו המ' (שיקפילו, 
<pgbrk id="pg832" />שיכפילו) up to the time when people lay the figs in layers; [oth. opin.: people fold up the 
<italic>knives</italic> (v. preced.) to store them away; oth. opin.: people fold up the 
<italic>matting</italic> on which the figs are dried before they are stored]. Ib. 62
<sup>a</sup>. Tosef. Dem. I, 3 משיקפלו המַקְצָעוֹת; Y. ib. I, beg. 21
<sup>c</sup> המקצועות.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02442">
<head-word>מִקְצָת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown"> קָצָה; v. קְצַת)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>a part</italic>; (adv.) 
<italic>partially, in some cases</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Shebu. VI, 3 הואיל והודה לו מ' ממין וכ' since he has admitted a part of what is comprised in the claim (empty ‘casks’ against the claim of ‘pitchers of oil’). Ib. הודה במִקְצַת כלים if he admits that he owes a portion of the vessels claimed.—B. Mets. 3
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. מודה (ב)מ' הטענה ישבע he who admits a portion of the claim must make oath. Y. Shebu. VII, beg. 38
<sup>b</sup> לפי שנהנה מ' ומהנה מ' וכ' because he is benefitted to a certain extent and benefits (the owner) to a certain extent, he must swear in some cases and pay damage in other cases. Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 9, ch. XI טמאת מ' וטהרת מ' you make it possible to declare (the seeds) unclean in some cases and clean in others. Ab. V, 8 מִקְצָתָן מעשרין ומקצתן וכ' if a part of the people give tithes and a part give not, v. בַּצּוֹרֶת. Koh. R. to VII, 27, a. e. מ' הנפש ככל הנפש loss of a part of one’s life (pain, loss of property &c.) is considered like a sacrifice of one’s entire life; a. fr.—Ch. v. קְצָת.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02443">
<head-word>מָקַק</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. מוּק)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to soften</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִמַּק, נִמּוֹק, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, נִימּ' 
<italic>to be softened; to decay; to be sqashed beyond recognition</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. X, 4 עד שיִמּוֹק הבשר until decay has set in. Bicc. I, 8 נִמַּקּוּ if the first fruits became decayed. Sifra B’ḥuck., Par. 2, ch. VIII (ref. to Lev. XXVI, 39) אינו אומר יִמַּקּוּ אלא יִמַּסּוּ it does not merely mean ‘they shall decay’ (when a portion remains sound), but ‘they shall dissolve’ (v. Macc. 24
<sup>a</sup> bot.). Nidd. III, 4 נִימּוֹק הולד וכ' the embryo may have been mashed (mixed up with the blood) before it was passed. Y. ib. III, end, 51
<sup>a</sup> נִימּוֹקָּה שלייתו וכ' the placenta was mashed. Bab. ib. 27
<sup>a</sup> אינו דומה נמוק פעם וכ' there is no comparison between one presumption that the embryo was mashed and two such suppositions (that the placenta of one embryo and the embryo of another placenta were mashed). R. Hash. III, 8 היו נִימּוֹקִּים they decayed (from the serpent’s bites), opp. מתרפאין; a. e.—Tanḥ. Noah 10 נמק יסודו; Yalk. Dan. 1060 נימק סידו, v. infra.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵמֵק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to squash</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40
<sup>c</sup> bot. שלא תָמֵיק וכ' lest she may squash the embryo in her womb.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to enervate, cause consumption.</italic></definition>
<notes> Keth. VII, 10 מְמַקְּתוֹ she (the intercourse with her) will enervate him (the leper).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּמַק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be crumbled, to dissolve</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 92
<sup>b</sup> ה' סורו (Rashi) his (Nebucadnezzar’s) pride was crumbled (he confessed his wrong), v. מָרַק; (ed. ה' סודו its (the kiln’s) foundation was crumbled (from the heat); [oth. vers. ה' סידו the lime in it melted; Tanḥ. Noah 10 נמק יסודו; Yalk. Dan. 1060 נימק סידו].</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpalp.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְמַקְמֵק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be crushed, to pine</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Taan. 25
<sup>b</sup> עד שיִתְמַקְמֵק ויצטער until he is made submissive (by starvation) and feels pain.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="M02614">
<head-word>מַרְזֵב</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (רזב, transpos.</definition>
<notes> of ברז; cmp. בָּרֵיז) </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>tube, spout;</italic> esp. 
<italic>the movable tube attached to the roof gutters</italic> (מַזְחִילָה).</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. III, 6 המ' אין לו חזקה no claim, based on undisturbed use, can be made for the special position of the pipe discharging the water into the neighbor’s yard; expl. ib. 58
<sup>b</sup>; Y. ib. III, end, 14
<sup>b</sup> מקום המ' בחצר יש … מקום קילוחו וכ' the right of a pipe for the discharge of water into the neighbor’s court can be claimed on the basis of undisturbed use, but not the special place of its discharge; (Tosef. ib. II, 13 צינור). Yeb. 75
<sup>b</sup> כמ' if the mutilated membrum has the shape of a spout (leaving the urinary canal unprotected). Sabb. 146
<sup>b</sup> גזירה משום מ' it is forbidden, lest he shape a regular tapping tube (v. בִּרְזָא I).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> a sort of 
<italic>cape</italic>, having the shape of a gutter, formed by throwing the edges of a garment over the shoulders backward.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 147
<sup>a</sup>, v. כִּיסָא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
